title: 序章25 吹奏人鱼湾序章26 异常
content_zh:
随着主持人的话音落地。
黎木所在笼门缓缓升起，露出了里面所有人。
由于方才凯斯队伍的过于出众，与之处在同一组的队伍自然受到了极大地关注。
所有人的目光都朝着笼门升起的方向看去。
好奇、轻蔑，下注、叫嚷，无数道不同的视线汇聚。
所有乐师都知道，这场必败。
他们只是被聘请而来的，凭什么让他们跟人鱼，跟那些家伙比试？
如果他们上场，在凯斯的煽动下，必然丢尽师门脸面，事后绝对会被逐出乐班，并且以后也没有人愿意收留他们。
如果他们不上场，同样会落下懦弱怯战的口舌，从此身败名裂。
这一刻，他们终于明白了，为什么玛丽伯爵出价那么高还少有人愿意接活，也终于明白，为什么他们天赋不佳，却还被师父“看好”
派来参赛。
乐班收钱，伯爵收人，原来只是乐班用来捞金的弃子，他们的人生至此结束了。
那一刻，乐师们觉得，平民似乎与那群奴隶也没什么区别。
在所有人的关注下，笼门后的人竟然没有第一时间走出来，也是全场比赛，第一次主持人演讲完，还没有任何动静的队伍。
那一刻，所有乐师都跟失去了灵魂一样，僵硬的站在原地。
“呼~吸~”
似乎外界的一切都与他们无关了，只有沉重的呼吸声是自己的。
“呼~吸~”
一次呼吸，两次呼吸...
整个赛场窃窃私语起来，玛丽伯爵的脸色也十分不好。

按照原本的计划，就算她是被比下去的那个，因为聘请来的终究是乐师，也总归不会太难堪，默默离开便是。
可凯斯如此明目张胆的操作比赛顺序，如此意义明确的针对自己实在超出预料。
因为玛丽早已在明面上失去了王爵继承权，实际上不会构成太大的竞争力影响。
凯斯也正是因此，才只是偶尔欺凌一下玛丽，而不是明面上针对，甚至下毒手。
如今也不知道他哪根弦搭错了，竟然如此强烈的针对，大大超出了预料。
“......”
随着时间推移，贵族们看看下面久久不动的奴隶，又看看玛丽的方向。
连王爵也忍不住看向玛丽的方向，不过面无表情，看不出喜乐。
整个赛场的气氛愈发诡异起来。
“踏~”
终于在此时，经过地面白花放大过的脚步声突然响起。
content_en:
As the host's words fell to the ground.
The door of Li Mu's cage slowly rose, revealing everyone inside.
Due to the outstanding performance of Keith's team just now, the teams in the same group naturally received great attention.
Everyone's eyes were looking in the direction of the cage door rising.
Curiosity, contempt, placing bets, shouting, countless different lines of sight gathered.
All musicians know that this is a losing battle.
They were just hired, why should they be allowed to compete with the mermaids and those guys?
If they go on stage, under Keith's instigation, they will definitely lose face as a teacher. They will definitely be expelled from the band afterwards, and no one will be willing to take them in in the future.
If they don't play, they will be said to be cowardly and timid, and their reputation will be ruined.
At this moment, they finally understood why Count Mary's bid was so high but few people were willing to take the job, and they finally understood why they were "favored" by their master despite their poor talents.
Sent to compete.
Leban collected money, and the Count accepted people. It turned out that they were just abandoned sons used by Leban to make money, and their lives were over.
At that moment, the musicians felt that there seemed to be no difference between the civilians and the group of slaves.
Under everyone's attention, the people behind the cage door did not come out immediately. It was also the first time in the whole game that after the host's speech, there was no movement from the team.
At that moment, all the musicians stood stiffly in place as if they had lost their souls.
"Breathe~breathe~"
It seemed that everything in the outside world had nothing to do with them, and only the sound of heavy breathing was their own.
"Breathe~breathe~"
One breath, two breaths...
The entire arena began to whisper, and Count Mary also looked very unhappy.
According to the original plan, even if she was the one being compared, since the person hired was a musician after all, it would not be too embarrassing and she could just leave silently.
But Case manipulated the order of the game so blatantly and targeted himself so clearly, which was beyond expectation.
Because Mary has already officially lost the right to inherit the kingship, it will not actually have much impact on competitiveness.
It was precisely because of this that Keith only bullied Mary occasionally, instead of openly targeting her or even being vicious.
Now I don't know which string he put on the wrong string, but he was so strongly targeted, which greatly exceeded his expectations.
"..."
As time passed, the nobles looked at the slaves below, who had been motionless for a long time, and then looked in the direction of Mary.
Even Wang Jue couldn't help but look in Mary's direction, but his face was expressionless and showed no joy.
The atmosphere in the entire arena became increasingly weird.
"Step~"
Finally, at this moment, the sound of footsteps amplified by the white flowers on the ground suddenly sounded.
